exposure.needed: whether any tooling or alerting reads Strimzi Pod-restart Kubernetes events and selects or filters them by regardingObject or related

consequence.statement: Pod-restart events now point to the Kafka resource in `regardingObject`, with the Pod in `related`. Any event consumer that keys on these fields will see them filled differently.
consequence.remediation: Check any event watchers, alerts or dashboards that look up Pod-restart events by `regardingObject`, and update them to use the Kafka resource or the `related` field.

assertion.statement: Kubernetes events that Strimzi emits during a Pod restart now have the Kafka resource as the `regardingObject` and the Pod in the `related` field.
